name: direct_convolution_correlation
decomposition_rationale: Decompose into separate boundary padding and sliding-window dot-product operators to allow changing boundary styles independently from the computational kernel.

atomic_nodes.name: pad_array_boundaries
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Applies chosen boundary conditions (e.g. constant, wrap, symmetric) to pad an array prior to spatial filtering.
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Expands the spatial dimensions of the input array by the specified pad widths.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: Allocates and populates a new padded array containing elements of the original.
